Lockheed Martin’s Aeronautics Company is seeking an early-career software engineer to support flight software and mission-system simulators. The role spans software development, CI/CD and automation, virtual development labs, and hardware/software integration and flight testing.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and debug software components for flight software and mission‑system simulators
Maintain and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable builds
Create and sustain automation tools and scripts that streamline development and test processes
Support virtual development labs and aircraft‑software workflows, providing day‑to‑day technical assistance
Participate in Agile meetings (stand‑ups, sprint planning, reviews, demos) and collaborate with cross‑functional teams and customers
Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
Ensures software standards are met

The successful candidate will be a member of a high performing team and must be self‑motivated with a strong work ethic, excellent time‑management, and strong interpersonal skills
Demonstrated proactive communication skills are required
Candidates must be U.S. citizens and able to obtain the required government security clearance
Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a STEM‑related discipline from an accredited university or college
Experience with C++, Python, and Java
Basic understanding of hardware and embedded systems
Hardware troubleshooting and/or software debugging experience

Experience with Atlassian tools, including Jira
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
